job_location: Berlin (Remote — Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK)
responsibilities: Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: data quality testing at every layer and reconciliation dominate, with no velocity phrases; decisive phrase "Set the data quality bar".
evidence.domain_risk: helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: a consumer nutrition app where errors affect product and monetization decisions, with no regulatory or financial-reporting language.
evidence.collaboration_width: Monetization team; product teams; engineering teams; PMs; engineering managers
evidence.data_team_maturity: Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: an established stack and embedded squad analysts, but the quality culture is still being built ("Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for").
evidence.jd_authorship: You'll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Hiring manager: bullets describe concrete weekly work (tracking, funnel experiments, testing at each layer, anomaly detection).
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Product: the audience is product squads, PMs and the Monetization squad's funnels and experiments.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: strategic leadership ("Set the data quality bar", "Own the path", "strategy side") plus hands-on analyst work ("Be the analyst for Monetization yourself").
evidence.ai_role: AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI user: the candidate is expected to use AI to write and check code and be critical of its output.
evidence.testing_framing: Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: the candidate defines the testing regime and moves quality ownership upstream.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: quality ownership leads the role summary, and the fear is wrong numbers reaching stakeholders ("held a number back because it didn't reconcile").
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed: a new data quality regime and culture are built on top of an existing production stack.
evidence.work_arrangement: This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.
evidence.loss_aversion: You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through — preventing wrong numbers reaching stakeholders is central.
